release-smoke.description: Pre-release smoke: one quick native class per major area (casting, party, client fx, journal, meditation, wildlife, content, research, commands, monsters, lore, world). A fast sanity check run once before a release; it does not replace the full 349-class native gate.

area-combat-bosses.description: Combat and bosses: damage gates, wild monster pressure, dungeon guardians, battlefields, sleeping blade, monsters, aura beasts, boss damage through armour, trees kept out of boss arenas.

area-combat-arts.description: Combat: all fifty sword arts end to end (about 12 minutes on its own).

area-combat-aura.description: Combat: aura wards, sword strings, momentum and aura effects.

area-rituals-parties.description: Rituals and parties: relay circles, party admission during release, excise, basinfill and farm-spell casts.

area-regions-worldgen.description: Regions and worldgen: Siltcrest wetlands, rootmolt placement, fungal nursery, reed refuge, rainshield.

area-items-crafting.description: Items and crafting: research library, learn-all fusion, familiar content systems, Weaver's Silk stow key.

area-guis-hud.description: GUIs and HUD: life journal, lore journal, quality settings, meditation, creature presentation.

area-feature-tour.description: Feature tour: broad screenshot walk through the mod's systems.

area-mounts-taming.description: Mounts and taming: book-tamed coffer mimics (follow, chest, pet, stay, save, spill) and berry-tamed thistle hedgehogs (sit, follow, heal, hoglets).

area-towns-guards.description: Towns and packet guards: the inn room chest shuts when its traveller walks off; the Cord screen inscribes no scroll for a spectator.
